$comment: The four linked vault libraries (docs/phase3-state-model.md §12 ruling A). AmpsVault is a DELEGATECALL consumer of all four; an unlinked artefact carries __$...$__ placeholders and cannot be deployed. script/02_Libraries.s.sol deploys them through the canonical CREATE2 factory at the salts below and rewrites this file. Addresses are zero until that script has run on the target chain. NOTE: these do NOT belong in foundry.toml's `libraries` key -- pinning them there would bake one chain's addresses into every test build.
factoryNote: Canonical deterministic-deployment proxy. Recorded as UNVERIFIED on 4663 in the plan's reference table: assert its code before relying on it.
deployOrderNote: VaultRolloutLib calls VaultPlacementLib.place, which is `public`, so its artefact carries a link reference and it must be built with --libraries pointing at the already-deployed VaultPlacementLib. The other three have no library link references of their own.
